The .SRCINFO file is a standard package metadata file for an AUR package. LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD follows standard Arch packaging practices. It uses a VCS source with sha256sums=('SKIP'), which is required for git sources. The prepare() function performs submodule init, removes unnecessary icon files, and runs svgo/oxipng for image optimization—all local operations. The build() function configures compiler flags and runs cmake build. No network downloads, eval, base64, or other suspicious commands are present. The package() function installs the LICENSE. All code is consistent with normal upstream build workflow.
</details>
